statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and transient loss of consciousness
There is concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of known sick sinus syndrome
The service is to correlate symptomatic events with potential bradyarrhythmias or pauses that may not be captured on a standard electrocardiogram
The diagnoses are I49.5, R42, and R55
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial reason is that coverage may be available through another payer pursuant to coordination of benefits protocols
Prairie State Medicaid is the secondary payer
